    SmallCool beans black bean dipBaked black bean dip with cheddar, salsa, sour cream and corn chipsHow to make it1 brown onion2 garlic clovesground cumin, to tastesmoked paprika, to taste2 x 400g tins of black beans1 lime150g cheddar150g fresh salsa100g sour cream1 jalapeño1 bunch coriander250g corn chips100ml waterFry the diced onion and the garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add the cumin and the smoked paprika, then the drained tins black beans and the water.Simmer 5 minutes and mash roughly with lime juice and salt.Spread in a baking dish, cover with the grated cheddar and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.Top with the salsa, the sour cream, sliced jalapeño and coriander.Serve with the corn chips.I like to party chilli cheese dogsGrilled franks in buns under beef chilli and melted cheddarHow to make it300g beef mince1 brown onionchilli powder, to tasteground cumin, to taste1 tbsp tomato paste200ml passata8 frankfurts8 hot dog buns120g cheddar1 white onionyellow mustard, to taste100ml waterBrown the beef mince with the diced onion.Add the chilli powder, the cumin, the tomato paste, the passata and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.Grill the frankfurts until blistered.Toast the hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with the grated cheddar.Grill 1 minute to melt, then finish with diced white onion and yellow mustard.BigNo tool in this pool cheeseburgersBurgers with cheese and pickle sauce. No tool in this poolHow to make it800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 tbsp mayonnaisetomato sauce, to tastemustard, to taste1 jar dill pickles1 iceberg lettuce4 sesame burger bunsShape the beef mince into patties slightly wider than the buns and season well.Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding the slices of American cheese each for the last minute.Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped dill pickles.Toast the sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.Rico's pyro-crew fish tacosCrisp battered fillets in warm tortillas with lime slaw, avocado and chipotle mayoHow to make it600g firm white fish fillets, in strips120g plain flour200ml soda water1 tsp smoked paprika500ml vegetable oil, for frying8 small flour tortillas250g shredded red cabbage2 limes1 avocado4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tbsp chipotle in adobo, choppedToss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.Whisk the flour, paprika and soda water into a batter.Dip the fish in the batter and fry in hot oil until golden.Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, sliced avocado and chipotle mayo, with lime wedges.SweetFifteen bus jump choc chip cookiesDark choc chip cookies.
